title: チケゾー配達日記～真心編～

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hmm! Now what should I choose?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, are you shopping for something? I guess your delivery service is on break for the day!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Maruzen! Well, I've got zero requests today, so I thought I'd send my own package instead!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My, that sounds tubular! I hope you'll deliver the most wonderful gift. ♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, now here's an awesome find! This is the perfect gift to cheer someone on! Next is…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The color of the ribbon… Gotta be red! I feel pumped just looking at it! Okay, now I need to…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to deliver this baby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's all… but… Hmm…
Oh, so this is where you were. I would like to know more about this delivery service of yours…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But it appears I should save such talk for later, given your gloomy demeanor. Are you dealing with some sort of trouble?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, you've got it all wrong! I'm about to go deliver my own package!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: At least that's the idea, but… It feels like something's still missing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I followed everyone's lead by putting thought into my gift and doing my best to wrap it. It should be perfect, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Hm. So you feel like you're not getting all of your feelings across. I can relate to that sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's only natural to want to fully express yourself when giving a gift to someone important.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And if that's the case, have you considered…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wow, thanks, Air Groove! That sounds amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm in my office powering through a mountain of paperwork, when…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock! Trainer, are you in there?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Tickezo's Delivery Service—a service you can rely on! You have a delivery! And the sender…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Is none other than me, Winning Ticket! Ehehe, go on and open it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tug apart the ribbon and gently prize off the wrapping paper. Inside is a piece of stretching equipment!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You can use this to strengthen your core and improve flexibility! I thought it might help lessen your physical fatigue!
choice_data_list: Wow! I'll be sure to put this to good use!
Wow! I'll be sure to put this to good use!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But wait! That's not all I have for you! For my next gift…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I, uh… Ohh, I'm getting butterflies…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've brought you a, well…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HERE YOU GO!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well you see, Air Groove gave me some good advice!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: She said that if I want to express my… true feelings, I should give you a bouquet along with my present!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm always telling you how grateful I am… But that's not enough!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: There's so much I can't put into words. Special feelings that lie deep, deep in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And I want you to accept all of these feelings! All of them!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So what do you think?! Do you like my gift?
choice_data_list: Of course I do! I'll treasure it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's aaawesooome!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… I'm all restless and itchy now. And my heart's pounding like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've never given anyone a bouquet before, hehe…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But this has been a great experience! Just like these pretty flowers, my feelings are in full bloom!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Y-you know what I mean! Urk, I'm getting itchy again…
choice_data_list: I love them! Let me grab a vase!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put the flowers I received from Winning Ticket into an empty vase.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, the red roses were my first pick!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The florist told me they symbolize passion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whether it's some tough love or genuine praise, you always do things for my sake. That's why I thought these flowers would be perfect for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's touching gift has made today one to remember.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put the flowers I received from Winning Ticket into an empty vase.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, the pink tulips were my first pick!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The florist told me they symbolize sincere affection!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're considerate of me as an individual and a runner. That's why I thought these flowers would be perfect for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's touching gift has made today one to remember.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put the flowers I received from Winning Ticket into an empty vase.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, the white roses were my first pick!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The florist told me they symbolize deep respect!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're always doing research for our races and training sessions. Plus, you've taught me all kinds of things!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's why I thought these flowers would be perfect for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's touching gift has made today one to remember.
